Compute Shannon-Wiener Diversity Index per Geographic Group

Source: R/functions.R
compute_shannon_diversity.Rd

Calculate the Shannon-Wiener diversity index H = -sum(p_i * ln(p_i)) per district or river basin, where p_i is the area proportion of each crop. Values are computed per year and averaged across years.

compute_shannon_diversity(data, agg_cols, group_col, group_geometries)

Arguments

data

sf or data.table with crop year columns and freq (area) column.

agg_cols

Character vector of year column names (Aggregated_YYYY or Name_YYYY).

group_col

Character string: grouping column name (e.g. "District" or "EZG").

group_geometries

sf object with geometries for the groups. Must have a column matching group_col and a geometry column.

Value

An sf object with columns: group_col, mean_shannon, and H_YYYY per year.
